disposition_reason: Mean ± SD iron, manganese, zinc, copper, nickel, cadmium and lead (fresh matter) in garden-grown parsley root and leaf, carrot root and leaf, onion, cabbage and lettuce from two old mining areas and a reference area in Banat, Romania. The fruit-vegetable table (Table 4) duplicates Table 3, so cucumber and green bean concentrations are not printed.

study.design: field survey of home gardens in two contaminated mining areas and one reference area; 8 samples per vegetable per area
study.origin: inhabitants' gardens at Ruschita and Moldova Noua (old mining areas) and Borlova (reference), Banat County, Romania
study.market: home-grown, also supplied to local markets
study.method: washed, oven-dried 80 °C, ashed, HNO3 solution; HR-CS flame AAS (ContrAA 300)
study.qa: CRM NCS DC 85104a and 85105a; recoveries Fe 92, Mn 95, Zn 102, Cu 105, Ni 99, Pb 94, Cd 105%; CV < 10%

findings.notes: n = 8 per vegetable and area as stated in Methods; asterisk marks p < 0.05 vs reference.

unresolved: Table 4 (fruit vegetables: cucumber, green beans) as published repeats the Table 3 leafy-vegetable rows verbatim (confirmed on page 4 render), so no cucumber or green bean concentrations are printed; green bean values exist only as daily intakes in Table 5 and were not back-calculated.
Cd values of 0.01 ± 0.00 equal the stated LOD.
